_readme: PARKED RESEARCHERS. Real people with complete entries, but not shown on the site right now. Only the sample profile ('yourname') is public, until EAGLOPEN is ready to publish real profiles. Nothing deletes this file, so they are always here to bring back. TO BRING THEM BACK: (1) run 'python research/_build/build.py --with-parked' to merge everyone in here into the build, or (2) copy the entries you want out of 'researchers' below into research/data/researchers.json alongside the sample. Before publishing, read each works entry: anything marked "placeholder": true shows a yellow 'Needs content' badge and is a prompt to fill in. No paper titles are invented here. Where a real citation is needed the entry says so instead of guessing.

researchers.name: Lencho Taye
researchers.headline: Founder and Executive Director of EAGLOPEN Science and Technology Organization.
researchers.field: Software development, entrepreneurship and community building
about: Lencho Taye founded EAGLOPEN Science and Technology Organization and serves as its Executive Director. He also founded AlgoLab, the hands-on programme where young people build and test working software.
He works as a student researcher and software developer. He won the STEM Science and Engineering Fair and was a finalist at the National Science and Engineering Competition.

His focus is practical: taking an idea from a sketch to something a person can actually use, then helping other young researchers do the same. He is an innovation and startup advocate, a community builder and a youth leadership advocate, and a member of the EAGLOPEN research team.

works.title: Founding and leading EAGLOPEN
works.summary: Built the research programme that gives young African researchers funded time, mentors and a public place to show their work.
works.result: Running the student research intake that produced the profiles on this site.
works.detail: EAGLOPEN exists to give students real research work rather than classroom exercises: mentorship, materials and equipment support, a review process, and a public showcase where each selected researcher gets a page like this one.

works.title: Founding AlgoLab
works.summary: Created the programming lab where members build working software and learn by testing it in front of others.
works.result: Members graduate having shipped projects rather than only completing exercises.
works.detail: AlgoLab is the build-first programme run under EAGLOPEN. Members pick a real problem, build a working version, get it reviewed, then teach the next cohort what they learned.

researchers.name: Dr. Tadele Negash
researchers.headline: Director of the University-Industry Linkage and Technology Transfer Directorate at Adama Science and Technology University.
researchers.field: Materials science, technology transfer and engineering innovation
about: Dr. Tadele Negash directs the University-Industry Linkage and Technology Transfer Directorate at Adama Science and Technology University.
He is an assistant professor, researcher and educator specialising in materials science, technology transfer and engineering innovation.

His work sits between the laboratory and industry: supporting collaboration between academia and industry, mentoring student researchers, and promoting innovation, intellectual property and inclusive technology development.
